content_fields.title: Test artifact signing (GitHub)
content_fields.description: Verify that released artifacts are signed and that signatures are checked before deployment.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means taking a released artifact, confirming its signature validates against the expected identity, and confirming the deployment path rejects an unsigned artifact.
content_fields.found: No release process or signed artifact exists.
content_fields.missing: A release pipeline producing signed artifacts.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification cannot be performed without a release process.
content_fields.action: The CI/CD owners should verify signing once a release process is in place.
